plan: A manipulative mage who jumps in, blows up her target and returns to where she started.
aSurveiller: Her W (Distortion). She jumps onto you then returns to her starting point: stay near your allies when she's missing from her lane.
contrer: Stay near your allies: she looks for isolated targets.
Her chain (E) roots you if you stay near her: move away.
When she's wounded, a clone appears: hit the real LeBlanc.

sorts.P: Turns invisible and creates a clone below 40% health.
sorts.Q: Sigil that detonates if she hits again.
